claims.statement: The EPBD requires Member States to establish renovation technical-assistance facilities, including one-stop shops, and promotes renovation finance tools; it does not award a private operator a lender relationship, commission or exclusive channel.
BGK's termomodernisation programme demonstrates a bank-routed financing workflow and lists multiple participating banks, while the enhanced grant application window closed on 30 June 2026.
Credit Agricole already offers an installer-assisted OZE credit process, including an electronic agreement, a stated decision time as short as 15 minutes and payment to the installer.
BNP Paribas already embeds OZE installment credit in participating shops and explicitly invites merchants to become credit-intermediation partners.
Energa and SGB market a combined technical, financing and implementation journey, so an energy incumbent can own the same one-stop-shop position proposed by the candidate.

Inbank reports more than 200 installer/distributor partners, more than 80,000 prior Polish green-installation loans and over 700 million PLN planned new financing, evidencing both demand and a scaled incumbent channel.

Consumer-credit intermediation is not shown to require an unobtainable right: KNF provides a registration process, but the business cannot begin covered activity merely on filing and must first obtain the register entry.

EU consumer-credit rules require intermediaries to disclose the extent of their powers and consumer-paid fees and to communicate relevant fees to the creditor; the exact Polish perimeter and operating controls need legal confirmation before a consumer-facing pilot.

A commercial-building, multi-lender document-orchestration wedge may be less directly served than household OZE credit, but the searched evidence does not establish commercial deal frequency, lender willingness or superior conversion.

No public evidence located establishes a 1%-3% lender-paid referral fee, installer software willingness to pay, channel exclusivity, funded conversion or consented outcome-data rights for this operator.

contrary_evidence: Multiple banks already embed credit through installers or merchants, including fast electronic flows and direct payment to the installer.
Inbank's reported 200-plus partner network and 80,000 prior loans indicate a scaled channel incumbent rather than an empty market.
Energa and SGB can bundle advice, financing and implementation, reducing the need for an independent router.
Consumer-credit intermediation is a registered activity with disclosure obligations; a workflow label does not remove the regulatory perimeter.
Policy-linked offers can change or expire, as shown by the 2026 cutoff for BGK's enhanced grant route.
